data.title: Chapter 23
data.content:
Hi beauties and gentlemen .

Sorry for the short chapter .

Lets start our story.


As they came back , they were welcomed by an unknown figure.


Veronica : (hugs Xander) Hi my love , I am here to claim you as mine (disgusting smile)


Xander / Sword : (breaks the hug) I told you not to come . (frowns)


Lily : Who is she


Veronica : (in attitude) Princess Veronica from Kritsburg Kingdom and Xander's fiance , you lowly humans . I don't wanna even talk to these shitty people .huh.

I won't go without Xander , who knows which bi*ch will seduce him (indirectly pointing towards Lily).


Noah / Wingston : (whispers to Lily ) She looks bi*chy.


Lily : Yes she is indeed (went inside with angry mood)


Miranda / Blast : Its better you mind your words you shit before I blast you like those buildings . (glares)


Calus / Vibrant : Its time for the guests to arrive , don't create scenes here .


Blake / Hack : And you just go away , don't spoil our mood now .(frowns)


Veronica : I will come back my lovely Xander and a nice surprise for you tonight (winks)


Xander / Sword : (frowns)


The night falls and its the time for partyyyyy.

Party Party Yeah


Everything was ready and the party mood was on .


Calus and Theo were greeting the guests while other Savers were enjoying and talking to other people.


In background

NIKA NIKA


ITS VERONICA


Veronica : (came wearing a black satin gown and whole loads of makeup) (smirks )


Everyone was seeing her

But

Suddenly the lights went off

And the smoke covered the room and the spotlights turned .


And the whole crowd was in awe .


As the birthday girl entered the room and she was wearing a red colored silk gown adored with beautiful flowers and the linings of gold. The gown looked so heavenly and so gorgeous that no one can resist her look . She looked so enchanting like a goddess descended from the heavens .


Veronica : (roll her eyes ) how dare she snatch my spotlight . Not even my match . (annoyed)


Theo / Warlord : And here comes the Star Of The Night , the prettiest birthday girl Lily .


Lily : (smirks) Only mine to claim.


Author : Lets meet in next episode cuties.

Bye

Love you
